india.one_line: India stresses AI conflict oversight at the UN as domestic enterprises adopt local AI agents and coding tools.

themes.title: Indian enterprises adopt local AI agents
themes.text: A KPMG and CII report shows 93 percent of Indian leaders plan to deploy AI agents, while Entire partnered with Sarvam AI to offer locally hosted coding agents.

stories.headline: Entire partners with Sarvam to bring AI coding agents to India
93% of Indian business leaders plan to adopt AI agents, report says

themes.title: India urges human oversight in conflict AI
themes.text: At a UN Security Council debate, India called for human oversight in the application of artificial intelligence during conflicts.

stories.headline: India stresses human oversight in AI use during conflicts at UN
